archetypes.name: dyn-stdout-contract
archetypes.rationale: New pre-driver stdout contract is load-bearing for Step 8 routing.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the new ship pre-driver verb and its CLI dispatch path. Verify it emits exactly one NEXT_ACTION line on stdout on every route, including guard, seed, OOS, and pre-version-gate failures. Check that child stdout and stderr cannot leak onto stdout. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: dyn-step8-routing
archetypes.rationale: Prompt and harness changes collapse three Step 8 fences into one route.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the Step 8 SKILL.md edits against the new CLI behavior. Verify retry idempotency, seeded-state handling, OOS filing, and active driver handoff remain consistent with the surrounding Step 8 routing prose and structure harness pins. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
